what: From probabilities to a full metric table
title: Getting started with poEvaluationMetrics
text: indexCalculation() expects data.frame columns predicted (numeric scores) observed (0/1), plus SpatRaster predictions (used Boyce/SBI sampling related steps).
code: library(terra) library(sf)  set.seed(1) r <- rast(   nrows = 80,   ncols = 80,   xmin = 0,   xmax = 1,   ymin = 0,   ymax = 1,   crs = "local" ) values(r) <- runif(ncell(r))  inputDF <- data.frame(   predicted = c(0.85, 0.72, 0.25, 0.41, 0.05, 0.91),   observed = c(1L, 1L, 0L, 0L, 0L, 1L) )  round(indexCalculation(inputDF, prediction = r), 4) #>   Fbp omissionRate SBI_tp SBI_cr SBI_bs SBI_ps SBI_ad  SBI_m SEDI ORSS AUC #> 1   2            0      1      1      1      1 0.9223 0.9991    0    1   1 #>      COR Spec Sens Kappa PCC TSS PRG   MAE   BIAS noPresencePoints #> 1 0.9282    1    1     1   1   1   1 0.205 0.0317                3

what: Presence and background as sf points
title: Getting started with poEvaluationMetrics
text: calculateMetrics() extracts values presence absence/background points, calls indexCalculation().
code: pres_coords <- data.frame(x = c(0.2, 0.35, 0.6), y = c(0.25, 0.7, 0.45)) bg_coords   <- data.frame(x = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.85), y = c(0.55, 0.15, 0.75))  presence <- st_as_sf(pres_coords, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = crs(r)) absence  <- st_as_sf(bg_coords, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = crs(r))  round(calculateMetrics(r, presence, absence), 4) #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully #>      Fbp omissionRate  SBI_tp SBI_cr SBI_bs SBI_ps SBI_ad  SBI_m   SEDI ORSS #> 1 0.6667       0.6667 -0.4069 0.0657 0.0669 -0.367  0.054 0.0741 0.8774    1 #>      AUC    COR Spec   Sens  Kappa    PCC    TSS  PRG    MAE   BIAS #> 1 0.3333 -0.173    1 0.3333 0.3333 0.6667 0.3333 -0.5 0.5495 0.1787 #>   noPresencePoints #> 1                3

title: Getting started with poEvaluationMetrics
text: performanceEstimation() combines presence–absence, presence–background (replicated background sampling), /presence–artificial-absence (AOA) evaluation. returns one data.frame scenario column (PA, PBG, PAA). chunk keeps replication small illustration. Turning aa = TRUE uses CAST slower; disable PAA use PBG vignette builds quickly. See ?performanceEstimation arguments design options.
code: env <- c(r, r * 0.8 + 0.1) names(env) <- c("v1", "v2")  pe_result <- performanceEstimation(   prediction = r,   presence = presence,   absence = absence,   background = TRUE,   aa = FALSE,   environmentalVariables = env,   noPointsTesting = 20,   replicates = 2 ) #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully #> Warning in newton(lsp = lsp, X = G$X, y = G$y, Eb = G$Eb, UrS = G$UrS, L = G$L, #> : Iteration limit reached without full convergence - check carefully  pe_result[, 1:8] #>   scenario       Fbp omissionRate     SBI_tp     SBI_cr     SBI_bs     SBI_ps #> 1       PA 0.6666667    0.6666667 -0.4102622 0.06091446 0.06212713 -0.3693533 #> 2      PBG 0.3095238    0.6666667 -0.1772434 0.05673406 0.05899522 -0.1458808 #>       SBI_ad #> 1 0.04270814 #> 2 0.03601108

what: Calculating Evaluation Metrics For Species Distribution Models
title: Calculating Evaluation Metrics For Species Distribution Models
text: R package evaluating species distribution models (SDMs): discrimination metrics (AUC, correlation, PRG), calibration-style error (MAE, bias), Boyce-type Spearman indices (SBI_* via smoothed GAMs), threshold-based scores (TSS, Kappa, omission, F1-style Fbp, SEDI, ORSS, etc.).

title: Calculating Evaluation Metrics For Species Distribution Models
text: Dependencies (beyond CRAN defaults) include terra, sf, CAST, predicts, mecofun, PresenceAbsence, prg, Metrics. must installed GitHub / Git: install poEvaluationMetrics (remaining CRAN dependencies install.packages needed): Vignette: installation, see vignette("poEvaluationMetrics", package = "poEvaluationMetrics").

title: Calculating Evaluation Metrics For Species Distribution Models
text: installing package: cite inst/CITATION entry reporting methods.

title: Calculating Evaluation Metrics For Species Distribution Models
text: High-level: run one evaluation designs (presence–absence, presence–background sampled background, presence–artificial-absence via AOA) optional replication PBG/PAA. presence required (default). Single map + one set absence/background points: Tabular data (continuous predictions + binary observed, plus raster Boyce/SBI sampling): Standalone helpers (binary classifications ): Fbp(), sedi(), orss(), omission(), brier_score(), fowlkes_mallows(), mcc(), tcr(). See ?Fbp help pages.
code: library(poEvaluationMetrics)  result <- performanceEstimation(   prediction = prediction_raster,           # terra::SpatRaster   presence = presence_sf,                   # sf — required   absence = absence_sf,                     # or FALSE to skip PA   background = TRUE,                        # or FALSE, or an sf object   aa = TRUE,                                # PAA via CAST::aoa; FALSE to skip   environmentalVariables = env_rasters,    # needed if background or aa is TRUE   noPointsTesting = 1000,                   # defaults to nrow(presence)   replicates = 50                           # mean over replicates for PBG/PAA )  # One row per scenario; use the `scenario` column (PA / PAA / PBG) result[result$scenario == "PBG", ] df_metrics <- calculateMetrics(prediction_raster, presence_sf, background_or_absence_sf) tab <- data.frame(predicted = c(0.2, 0.8, 0.1), observed = c(0L, 1L, 0L)) indexCalculation(tab, prediction_raster)

title: SDM performance evaluation — performanceEstimation
text: Evaluates performance species distribution models (SDMs). evaluation supports three data types: presence-absence (PA), presence-artificial-absence (PAA), presence-background (PBG). Metrics include predictive accuracy (AUC, COR), predictive error measures (MAE, BIAS), across cross-validation replicates.

title: SDM performance evaluation — performanceEstimation
code: performanceEstimation(   prediction,   presence,   absence = FALSE,   background = TRUE,   aa = TRUE,   environmentalVariables = NA,   noPointsTesting = NA,   replicates = 100 )

Number background artificial absence points generate sampling. replicates Integer. Number replicate draws PBG/PAA; column-wise means across replicates returned scenarios.
